exercises.why: From Wiktionary: поручи́ться — to warrant, to guarantee, to certify, to answer for, to vouch for; ручо́нка — (small) hand, (small) arm; безру́кий — armless (without arms); рукоя́тка — handle, grip, hilt (part of an object which is held in the hand when used or moved).
